comment:
Second fix round, on the dusk test render looking down Pike Street at the sign. The sign's frame and bulbs are right now; keep them, its size and its facing. Fix only:
1. The letters glow white (bare glowstone/lamps). They must read RED NEON: build each letter stroke as red stained glass (or red stained glass panes) with the light source directly behind it, so the glow is red, and outline them with a thin rim of red concrete or red terracotta. No bare white light blocks in the letters.
2. Make sure the two lines read: PUBLIC MARKET on top, CENTER below it, centred under the top line, both fully inside the frame and unobstructed from Pike Street (+x/+z side). Letters at least 5 blocks tall on the top line, 4 on the lower.
3. The clock face below at the corner: keep it, but give its ring the same red neon (red stained glass with light behind) so it reads at dusk.
summary:
The sign letters now show only red light: the glowstone behind each red glass stroke is covered on its top, bottom, sides and back by red terracotta, which also gives each letter a thin red rim.
The clock's red glass ring, already lit by glowstone in the wall behind it, now has the same thin red terracotta rim around the outside.
Frame, bulbs, size, facing and everything else are unchanged; the diff against v2 is only 453 red_terracotta cells at the sign and clock.
applied: 1. Red neon letters: kept each stroke as red_stained_glass at x39 with glowstone directly behind it at x38. The glowstone's top, sides and back were open to the air and showed bare white light from Pike Street at an angle; now a red_terracotta rim in the x38 layer covers its top, bottom and sides, and red_terracotta at x37 closes its back. Light only comes out through the red glass, and no glowstone face shows from the street. The rim cells are held by the existing iron-bar lattice, so no new orphan blocks.

2. Two lines: PUBLIC MARKET on top (y 54..58) and CENTER below (y 46..50), both 5 tall and centred on z 283, fully inside their frames. Checked that x40..41 in front of the letters and the +z side hold no blocks, so the view from Pike Street is clear.

3. Clock: kept the face and its ring of red_stained_glass, already lit by glowstone in the wall at x40 behind each ring cell. Added a thin red_terracotta rim around the outside of the ring (x41, inside the 7x7 clock space) to match the letters.
skipped: Can't be fully done at this size: the letters are one block apart, so the 'thin rim' fills the gaps behind them, and seen straight on the words sit on a red band rather than open sky. In the daylight render glass and terracotta are similar reds; the dusk contrast (glowing glass against the darker rim) couldn't be checked because the renderer has no light.
Left alone because the comment didn't mention them: two floating chimney stacks on the C roof (104 blocks) and the remaining orphan blocks, all already in v2.
